name: yf_recommendations
description:
Analyst recommendation counts for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance recommendations).
Returns: {symbol, recommendations: [{period (0m = this month, -1m, -2m, -3m), strongBuy, buy, hold, sell, strongSell}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Individual rating changes: yf_upgrades_downgrades; price targets: yf_analyst_price_targets. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "NVDA"}
